organization.name: BigCommerce; Commerce.com, Inc.
organization.notes: BigCommerce launched 2009; parent renamed from BigCommerce Holdings to Commerce.com July 2025 and ticker changed from BIGC to CMRC. Equity investors listed are historical growth-round participants, not current holdings.

pricingTiers.name: Core
pricingTiers.notes: Current 2026 plan names. Annual $29/month ×12; $30K trailing-twelve-month GMV cap, auto-upgrades. Payment-provider fees can apply.

pricingTiers.name: Scale
pricingTiers.notes: Explicit Most Popular. $299/month annual ×12; $33,333 monthly GMV cap and 0.9% overage; payment-provider fees separate.

pricingTiers.name: Growth
pricingTiers.notes: Closest established-business organizational plan; $79/month annual ×12, $100K TTM GMV cap. Not legacy Plus.

pricingTiers.name: Performance
pricingTiers.notes: Custom pricing starts $1,499/month billed annually ×12. Published starting floor, final contracted price custom; no month-to-month amount verified.

moats.claim: Established commerce integrations and combined B2B/B2C workflows create specialized integration and migration costs.

productReasons.claim: B2B purchasing features support company buyer accounts and business-specific procurement workflows.
Multi-storefront capabilities let a merchant operate multiple brands or regions through one commerce platform.
Headless storefront and integration APIs let merchants customize the buying experience around existing business systems.
